resources.string: GameTimer is active on this phone
This is the child\'s side of GameTimer. First choose a parent PIN: it protects connecting a parent\'s phone and the agent\'s settings. Use a PIN your child doesn\'t know (not the phone\'s own PIN).
The PIN must be 4 to 12 digits
The agent\'s saved data can\'t be read (for example right after a restart, before the phone was unlocked). Unlock the phone and reopen the app; if it stays like this, start over.
The agent couldn\'t start. Reopen the app.
Reachable from anywhere once a parent\'s phone is connected
Not on Wi-Fi: parents reach this phone through the relay
This creates a new identity for this phone: every parent\'s phone must connect again. Continue?
No parent\'s phone is connected yet
That phone can no longer see or control this one, until it is connected again.
Connecting a parent\'s phone needs both phones on the same Wi-Fi.
Two phones scanned the same QR code, so it was cancelled (the code may have been photographed). Start again.
So that the parents can always reach this phone, allow GameTimer to run in the background without battery restrictions.
On the parent\'s phone, open GameTimer, tap Add device and scan this code. Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Enter the 6-digit code shown on that phone.
Too many wrong tries. Try again in %1$d s
%1$s is closed: the game time is used up. You can ask a parent for more.
%1$s isn\'t allowed at this time of day.
Asked. A parent answers on their phone.
A parent said no. You can ask again in a few minutes.
Blocking games needs both permissions below.
Android may grey these out for an app installed from a file: open App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then grant them.
Display over other apps (the block page)
Blocks a game the moment it opens, and closes the settings screens that would switch this app off. Needs device admin and the accessibility service.
Strict mode is paused for 10 minutes
Strict mode is on, but a permission it needs was switched off
Lets GameTimer stay installed while the parents\' limits apply. Switch it off here before uninstalling.
This switches off the screen-time limits your parents set.

GameTimer Child: closes the games your parents limited as soon as they open, and keeps the settings that would switch this app off closed while strict mode is on. It reads only which app and screen is open; nothing leaves the phone.
